findings.description: PaymentLedger.charge() appends unconditionally; a retried payment request for the same order (gateway retries carry a NEW payment_id) charges the customer twice.
findings.suggestion: Make charging idempotent per order_id (one charge per order); a repeated request must return the existing charge unchanged.
findings.expected_behavior: total_for_order(1) stays 500 after a second charge request for order 1 with a different payment_id
